time_zone: fixed IANA; once requires explicit offset when ambiguous; daily skips missing and chooses earlier repeated instant; interval advances on a persisted UTC lattice
interval: positive PostgreSQL int4 minutes; create/edit/resume starts at database now plus interval; missed points collapse to the latest due point
editor_target: nullable owner-validated Editor session captured on the definition and copied immutably to each trigger
dispatch: service-scoped claim and lease; dispatch/reconcile/idle action; server-issued trigger-bound authority; idempotent chat_task_session; persistent unknown-result recheck without model replay
date_projection: owner-scoped UTC interval including persisted next interval point and trigger history
editor_grant: scheduled-chat authority may create one editor-stdio grant only for the captured owner-validated Editor session
